name: vision_superres
title: ESRGAN 4x super-resolution: two optimizers, two GradScalers, a relativistic discriminator and a frozen VGG perceptual loss
origin: domain-vision round 2: the two-optimizer GAN with AMP. Its discriminator step legitimately precedes the generator's backward (MLV203's documented trap) and its frozen VGG runs a forward pass inside the training loop without being trained

forbidden.why: there is no sklearn transformer in this project
the training loader is built with shuffle=True
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
eval_pipeline() is ToTensor only, and the geometric augmentation in __getitem__ is guarded by self.train, which the validation dataset never sets
both optimizers zero their gradients at the top of their own half of the step
both scalers step their optimizer every batch

THE TRAP: d_scaler.step(d_optimizer) at line 82 precedes g_scaler.scale(g_loss).backward() at line 100. They are two separate graphs over two disjoint parameter sets, which is exactly the multi-optimizer GAN shape MLV203's false-positive note exists for
the only no_grad region is the decorated validate(), which contains no backward()
both running totals accumulate .item(), and the PSNR total accumulates a Python float returned by models.psnr()
MultiStepLR is an epoch schedule and both schedulers are stepped in the epoch loop
both scalers follow the full protocol: scale(loss).backward(), unscale_ before the clip on the generator, step(optimizer), update()
clip_grad_norm_ runs between the generator's backward and its step, after unscale_
validate() calls generator.eval() before the loop and generator.train() on the way out; VGGFeatures pins itself to eval mode with a train() override
validate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
THE TRAP: the discriminator returns a raw score and the criterion is nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss - the correct pairing. There is no sigmoid anywhere in models.py
same - Discriminator.classifier ends in nn.Linear(128, 1) with no activation, which is what BCEWithLogitsLoss wants
generator, discriminator and features are all moved with .to(device), and both members of every pair are moved inside the loop
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
there is no split in this project - train/ and val/ are separate directories on disk
DenseBlock, RRDB, Generator, Discriminator and VGGFeatures all call super().__init__() first
every submodule container is nn.ModuleList or nn.Sequential
torch.save writes state_dict()s and torch.load passes map_location="cpu", weights_only=True
